dogOwnership.quote: un taux de possession qui chute à 25% dans les grandes villes et même 22% dans l’agglomération parisienne
dogOwnership.modelTransfer: Applied to local households as an explicit proxy; not a measured Châtillon household rate

behavior.notes: Simulated urinary events include marking and elimination without distinguishing them. Event counts and sampled pause durations are retained; normalized placement mixes uniform route locations with attraction near true physical junctions. No measured door preference, wall-corner or right-angle preference is assumed.

reference.defecationUse: Historical short-observation rate, no longer linearly extrapolated to full-day defecation counts

behavior.modelTransfer: Urination observational mean extrapolated to walks with expected pause time accounted for; not a local calibration or clinical norm. Poisson arrivals, uniform individual factor 0.5 to 1.5 and junction-placement coefficients are unvalidated modeling assumptions. Illustrative pauses are not clinically measured urination durations. Junction attraction qualitatively extrapolates observations of free-ranging males to companion dogs without known sex or territory.
behavior.defecationNotes: Daily per-dog Poisson count allocated among outings in proportion to actual moving duration. More or longer walks do not increase the daily expected count. Slider 0 to 4 is a scenario range, not a clinical maximum; no individual hard cap. These are events during public walks; private-garden elimination and fecal collection are not modeled. Mean, Poisson distribution and pause duration are assumptions, not locally calibrated medical norms.

behavior.durationMinutesMeaning: Target duration; achieved trip duration is sum of segment distance / segment moving speed plus urinary, fecal, sniffing and pedestrian-crossing pauses

walkingSpeedMetersPerMinute.meaning: The uniform 50–80 m/min base is fixed per dog. Actual segment speed varies gradually by street and slows approaching turns or crossings.

behavior.scheduleNotes: Minimum rest interval enforced between outings of each dog including the midnight boundary; modeling constraint, not a veterinary recommendation
behavior.routeSelection: Plan a connected return-to-home outing with local, familiar or mapped-green-space intention, a reference-circuit repertoire capped at 2–4 per dog and populated as outings are planned, destination feasibility and a reserved return budget. Favor street continuity and limit unnecessary turns, crossings and repeated segments. Prefer continuing forward on return within the complete moving-distance budget times 1.12, rather than capping an asymmetric circuit return at 1.5 times the shortest return from an arbitrary waypoint. Ordinary goals exclude straight OSM subdivisions and residential projections; retain junctions, dead ends and bends over 35 degrees. Remove retraced branches from circuits unless they reach a dead end or a requested green destination; recompute distances on the retained path and penalize other immediate reversals in route comparison. A complete out-and-back remains available on constrained networks or budgets. All preference coefficients and routine counts are unvalidated scenario choices.

defecationReferences.title: Apparent total tract nutrient digestibility and metabolizable energy estimation in commercial fresh and extruded dry kibble dog foods
defecationReferences.limits: Small short dietary cohorts; diet-sensitive frequency, not a clinical reference interval or calibration of public-walk events in Chatillon

defecationReferences.title: Effects of microalgae as dietary supplement on palatability, digestibility, fecal metabolites, and microbiota in healthy dogs
defecationReferences.limits: Adult Beagle dietary trials; selected diet means, not population limits or a public-walk calibration

sniffing.placement: Modest scenario preference for known green segments; never a shortcut off the accessible network
sniffing.counting: Extends trip duration and contributes to walking presence; excluded from all elimination counters, heat and persistent elimination markers
sniffing.status: Observation supports including sniffing as a separate behaviour; rate, duration and placement coefficients are unvalidated simulation assumptions

crossingWaits.source: OpenStreetMap crossing nodes and crossing-way metadata when present
crossingWaits.counting: Extends trip duration and contributes to walking presence; excluded from all elimination counters, heat and persistent elimination markers
crossingWaits.status: Unvalidated scenario assumptions; no live traffic or signal-state data and incomplete OSM crossing coverage

greenRoutePreference.status: unvalidated scenario assumptions, not local behavioural calibration
greenRoutePreference.routeComparison: Green segment share contributes to route score; physical distances remain unchanged
greenRoutePreference.destinationSelection: Network proximity and necessary detour within the moving-distance budget
greenRoutePreference.individualAffinity: Stable per-dog affinity changes the chance of choosing a green-space intention
greenRoutePreference.accessLimit: Known access, pedestrian and dog prohibitions are excluded. A mapped walkable network and absence of a known prohibition do not confirm current on-site or canine access. Destinations may have accessKnown=false.
greenRoutePreference.feasibility: Shortest mapped round trip to a green destination must fit estimated moving-distance budget times 1.12

greenIntentProbability.formula: dayMultiplier * individualAffinity * proximityFactor * periodFactor, only with a feasible destination and 6 <= hour < 23

greenRoutePreference.nearbyGreenOnOtherIntents: Local and familiar outings may consider a mapped nearby green waypoint when its shortest round trip is below 0.55 of the moving-distance budget, while keeping the complete outing within the return budget

referenceCircuits.initialization: Populated lazily while planning outings; small networks can offer fewer distinct suitable circuits

urinationPlacement.normalization: Normalized placement distribution retains the already sampled global Poisson event count and pause durations; no extra events or time are added
urinationPlacement.limitations: No known individual sex, posture, territory or conspecific scent history; qualitative transfer from free-ranging territorial marking to companion dogs; not a local calibration

countermarking.meaning: Urination over or adjacent to another dog scent mark is documented
countermarking.modelInterpretation: Current heat is cumulative event count, not detectable scent or an inter-dog countermarking model

scentPersistence.status: No validated fixed end-of-attraction threshold identified for outdoor companion-dog urine marks
scentPersistence.interpretation: Detectability, attraction and triggering a countermark are different outcomes; cumulative heat represents events, not residual odour strength or persistence
scentPersistence.numericTransfer: No persistence duration, chemical decay coefficient or inter-dog attraction coefficient is transferred from these studies

dailyHeat.aggregation: Weighted urination and defecation events only in [00:00, selected time), periodically assigned to a 24 h day; sniffing and pedestrian-crossing stops excluded
dailyHeat.normalization: Normalized compact kernel; color maximum fixed to complete-day maximum for selected scenario and event type, recalculated when either changes. Equal colors are not equal absolute quantities across scenarios.
dailyHeat.urbanism: Residential surface times levels weights departures; accessible street network constrains routes. No clinically validated park, tree, facade or paving multiplier.
dailyHeat.meaning: Theoretical event concentration, not measured contamination, urine volume, health risk, or abandoned feces

observationPrecision: 5 m is a geometric query radius on simulated sampled routes, not a guarantee of positional or statistical accuracy; OSM completeness and the weighted sample limit interpretation
reproducibility: CSV exports scenario settings and seed. Exact reproduction also requires identical geographic data and simulator version.

mappedGreenDestinations.meaning: Destinations connected to the mapped walking network without a known prohibition; all 10 embedded destinations lack explicit access information. These are candidates, not confirmed dog-accessible parks.
